decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends the firm's core spraying know-how into corrosion-protection applications, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search, so slack allows the firm to carry it while results mature.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established construction-repair offer, has its own web page and needs few extra resources, so it likely meets aspirations and there is no reason to withdraw it.

The multi-model transfer pump line builds on core conveying competence and in-house manufacturing, and with sales likely at or above aspiration in a growing market, dropping it soon after launch would be premature.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization strategy and has its own web page, so despite some uncertainty about adoption, available slack and its strategic fit argue for keeping it.
